import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    best_dif = 1e9
    best_a = best_b = 0
    for b in range(1, n + 1):
        a1 = math.ceil(b * x / y)
        a2 = math.floor(b * x / y)
        diff1 = abs(x / y - a1 / b)
        diff2 = abs(x / y - a2 / b)
        if diff2 < best_dif:
            best_dif = diff2
            best_a = a2
            best_b = b
        elif diff1 < best_dif:
            best_dif = diff1
            best_a = a1
            best_b = b
    print(f"{int(best_a)}/{int(best_b)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
